title: Time and spending anecdotes
summary: This topic groups scattered mentions of comfort after driving alongside time, cost, rental, and paperwork anecdotes, with most examples lacking clear evaluative sentiment.

positive.summary: The positive example says the vehicle felt very comfortable after time spent driving it.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention purchase price, hours spent explaining or processing paperwork, and rental-car costs without enough context to classify sentiment.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are too short or context-poor to determine sentiment reliably.
The topic mixes unrelated subjects such as driving comfort, purchase cost, rental expense, and lease processing time, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
